description_en: Queries the column encryption algorithms supported by an instance
description_zh: 查询实例支持的列加密算法
name: ListDataMaskingEncryptionAlgorithms

parameters.help_en: The cloud product type identifier. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2. If specified together with ProductCode, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identifier. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of ListDataMaskingInstances
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The language of the response descriptions. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Algorithms.description_en: The list of column encryption algorithms

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code for the record or operation. This value can be empty if no error occurs. Evaluate this value together with ErrorMessage
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误码。无错误时可为空；应结合 ErrorMessage 判断

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error description for the record or operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
